mstts:express-as.prosody: Have you ever felt like financial freedom is just out of reach, tangled up in a mix of emotions, habits, and the pressures all around us? If you’re nodding your head, you’re definitely not alone. The truth is, taking back control of your money isn’t just about crunching numbers or sticking to a tight budget. It’s about digging deep—uncovering the stories and beliefs that drive every decision we make about money. In her book, My Money My Way: Taking Back Control of Your Financial Life, Kumiko Love invites us to explore this journey together. She gets right to the heart of what so many of us struggle with—showing how self-awareness and a little kindness toward ourselves can completely change the way we handle our finances. What if you could let go of shame, and start seeing your money as a tool for building the life you truly want? That’s the kind of empowerment Kumiko Love brings—helping us rethink what financial success actually means for each of us. Instead of focusing on strict rules or feeling deprived, we get to create a system that feels right for our own goals and circumstances. As we move forward together, the focus shifts from overwhelm and confusion to clarity, purpose, and a sense of real possibility. Welcome to this journey—where money starts working for you, not the other way around.
